title: Which platform is better? Facebook Ads, Google Ads, or TikTok Shop? 🫣
description: Which platform is better? Facebook Ads, Google Ads, or TikTok Shop? 🫣
transcript: What's better? Facebook ads, Google ads, or TikTok shop? Well, the fastest growing brands are not picking just one platform today. They're using each channel for a very different job. Facebook ads create demand by getting your product in front of people who did not know they even needed it. This is where hooks, U G C demos, statics, and founder stories make someone stop scrolling and think I need that. Google captures your demand. When someone sees your ad, watches a creator, or hears about your product, they search it. Google captures that intent. TikTok Shop distributes demand. It turns creator videos into a sales force. Billies posting your product. They demo it, review it, go live with it, answer objections, and create social proof at scale. Then all of that overflows into every other channel. Someone sees you on TikTok, then buys on Amazon. Someone watches a creator, then Googles your brand. Someone sees a live, then visits your website. This is the modern day funnel. Let me know which platform you think is the best. All of them or just one?
